title: "The practice data"

## Where it comes from {#source}

The practice data is {{< var data.rows >}} rows from a knitting factory's daily production reports, June 1 to
August 28, 2022. {{< var source.author >}} of Daffodil International University published the reports on Mendeley
Data, along with a cleaned version, under a {{< var source.license >}} license. We use it because it's the kind of
spreadsheet researchers really get: typed by people under time pressure, with gaps and odd entries.

The dataset's description says the reports are from 2023. The dates in the data itself are 2022.

**Cite it as:** {{< var source.citation >}} [{{< var data.doi >}}]({{< var data.doi >}})

## What one row is {#row}

One lot knitted on one day, on a machine of a given brand and size. The table doesn't say which machine. The same
lot can appear on several rows in a day, and the same fabric specification appears on many days.

## The columns {#columns}

{{< include _dictionary.md >}}

## What we changed {#changes}

- We kept {{< var data.columns >}} of the 38 columns and gave them names with units.
- **Composition** is the text as it was typed in the factory's report. The published, cleaned version groups the
  blends into six categories, and it puts some of them in the wrong one. Working from the original text is the
  realistic task.
- We saved the file as UTF-8, removed invisible non-breaking spaces, and made the dates real dates.

Nothing else is changed. Blanks, repeated rows and odd values are as the factory recorded them. Finding them is part
of the session.

## Downloads {#downloads}

- **Your own copy of the Google Sheet** (recommended): the [copy link]({{< var sheet.copy >}}). See
  [Setup](setup.qmd#copy).
- [knitting-practice.csv]({{< var data.csv >}}){download=""} ({{< var data.csv-size >}}): just the data, for
  other tools.
- [knitting-practice.xlsx]({{< var data.xlsx >}}){download=""} ({{< var data.xlsx-size >}}): all five tabs, for Excel
  or LibreOffice.
- The original files, including the raw report: [Mendeley Data]({{< var source.page >}}).

## Reusing it {#reuse}

The data is licensed {{< var source.license >}}: you can share and adapt it, as long as you credit
{{< var source.author >}} and say what you changed. The list above covers our changes.
